sentences.en: The instinct for survival is inherent in every living thing.
sentences.zh: 每种生物都天生具有求生的本能。

sentences.en: I knew my only chance was to trust my instincts.
sentences.zh: 我知道唯一的希望就是听从直觉。

sentences.en: The instinct of self-defense is inherent in any animal.
sentences.zh: 任何动物都有自我保护的天性。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（内）+stinct（刺激）→内在的刺激→本能
